'''Luona''' was a [[Gender/Legends|female]] alive<ref name="Orbit" /> in [[0 ABY/Legends|0 ABY]].<ref name="Orbit Date">{{FarOrbitDate}}</ref>

{{RPGseed}}
After meeting an individual in a bar, Luona had sent fifty-seven messages to the person's rented quarters on the [[Space station/Legends|space station]] [[StarForge Station]] by the following [[Standard week/Legends|week]]. Due to this, the individual left and joined the crew of the [[EF76 Nebulon-B escort frigate/Legends|EF76 Nebulon-B escort frigate]] ''[[Far Orbit]]'', a [[Privateer/Legends|privateering]] vessel working for the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Alliance to Restore the Republic]] after many of the ship's personnel [[Mutiny on the Far Orbit|mutinied]] from under the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire's]] control, when the [[Frigate/Legends|frigate]] docked at the station looking for crew.<ref name="Orbit" />
{{Endgame}}

==Behind the scenes==
Luona was first mentioned in ''[[Preparing for War]]'', an adventure scenario in [[1998]]'s ''[[The Far Orbit Project]]'', by [[Timothy S. O'Brien]]. The book was a supplement to [[West End Games]]'s ''[[Star Wars: The Roleplaying Game]]'' and had the same theme of the previous publication ''[[Pirates & Privateers]]'', as the supplement followed the privateering vessel ''Far Orbit''. They were mentioned under the heading titled "Avoiding a social misunderstanding," which was part of a section that gave examples of reasons those players who had non-mutineer characters could have for leaving StarForge Station.<ref name="Orbit" />
